_description: Simulation study config for run_experiment.py. Keys starting with '_' are ignored.
_simulation: One dataset (run without --grid). mode: template | concov (then also con, cov). fuzzvalues: makeFuzzy noise; larger values push memberships toward .5 and lower PRI of the true rows (0.2 clean, 0.4 hard); keep <= 0.45.
_grid: Every n x noise x frag x fuzzvalues x rep (with --grid).
_qca_rule: OUT rule used by the optimizer AND for scoring every mode, computed once per dataset from the raw data: 'conventional' (n.cut keeps >= 80% of cases, incl >= .80, PRI >= .50), 'data_driven' (n.cut, incl, PRI from gaps in the data), or {"nu": "auto" | int, "tau": .., "pi": ..}.
_expert: Simulated imperfect expert = true anchors + error (crossover moved by N(0, error)*(i-e)).
_modes: mode: oracle | quantile | kde | expert | optimize. For optimize: params (overrides), n_seeds, expert ('noisy' = box around the simulated expert's crossover, 'truth_box' = optimistic box around the TRUE crossover), expert_box (half-width as share of (i - e)), profile (grid points for the stability profile).
